QuestInfo.name: Suspicious Movement on the Path
QuestInfo.1: You must defeat Death Teddies in Forgotten Path of Time <3> while Sodane continues his investigation.

0.0: I keep an eye on Ludibrium. It's a tough gig, but somebody's gotta do it.
0.1: Something's been bothering me for a while now. It was a long time back, but something really strange happened in the bottom floors of the Clocktower. I think there may have been more meaning to it than I'd previously suspected.
0.2: The day the Clocktower broke down, I thought I saw a strange figure moving around in the works. I figured it was just one of the monsters that lives in there, but then the whole thing shut down. I didn't think much of it at the time, but now it seems... fishy.
0.3: If you're willing to help out, I think the two of us could get to the bottom of this.

yes.0: I need you to hold off the #b#o7130010##k hordes at the #m220070200# on the Clocktower Bottom Floor while I gather evidence around the area. So you'd basically be bait. But you're good at that, right?

no.0: What? Are you scared of a few monsters?

1.0: Did you take care of all those #o7130010# jerks?

yes.0: Wow, you really stuck to it, didn't you? It only took me about ten minutes to get the information I needed.

mob.0: I'm going to need some time! Fight like, I don't know, 150 of the #o7130010# beasts in #m220070200#. That should be enough.
